sources.title: Claude 2
sources.evidence: July 11, 2023 launch announcement names Claude 2, makes it available through the API and public chat beta, and specifies prompts up to 100K tokens and text responses.

sources.title: Model Card and Evaluations for Claude Models
sources.evidence: The original Claude 2 card identifies Anthropic as developer and explicitly describes a Transformer trained with unsupervised learning, RLHF and Constitutional AI. It does not disclose a total or active parameter count or dense/MoE classification.

sources.title: Model Card and Evaluations for Claude Models, with Claude 2.1 appendix
sources.evidence: November 21, 2023 appendix explicitly calls the original model Claude 2.0. It says Claude 2.0 was trained for 200K context but its initial product launch supported only 100K; 2.1 added full 200K product support. No parameter counts are reported.

sources.title: The Claude 3 Model Family: Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, with 3.5 addenda
sources.evidence: Later first-party card, including June and October 2024 addenda, has comparison tables explicitly labeling Claude 2 and Claude 2.0, including multilingual MMLU and QuALITY. Those comparisons contain performance scores, not Claude 2.0 total or active parameter counts. The web PDF reader rejected its 46.8 MB size; the official PDF was successfully fetched and text-extracted with curl and pdftotext.

sources.title: Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy, Version 1.0
sources.evidence: Effective September 19, 2023, page 5 explicitly classifies then-current Claude 2 as ASL-2. Its containment measures treat model weights as core intellectual property, restrict access by job function and secure them against unsanctioned release. This is contemporaneous weight-access evidence rather than an inference from API hosting.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: The accessed terms are effective June 17, 2025, before Claude 2.0 retirement. They grant conditional service use and expressly do not grant rights to the other party's intellectual property except as stated; they are not a public model-weight license.

sources.title: Model deprecations
sources.evidence: Current retirement history explicitly maps Claude 2 to claude-2.0 and records retirement on July 21, 2025, separately from claude-2.1. Retired endpoints are no longer available for use.

sources.title: Introducing Claude 2.1
sources.evidence: November 21, 2023 announcement names Claude 2.0 as the preceding model and announces API tool use as a new beta feature alongside Claude 2.1. It cannot establish the same native feature for 2.0.

sources.title: Write a custom parser Lambda function in Amazon Bedrock Agents
sources.evidence: Official Bedrock Agents documentation includes an explicitly labeled Claude 2.0 orchestration parser that extracts function_call and scratchpad content from raw model output. This establishes a provider-orchestrated integration, but does not establish native Anthropic API tool-call or extended-thinking support.

sources.title: Supported foundation models in Amazon Bedrock (indexed historical table)
sources.evidence: The complete indexed primary table lists Claude 2 / anthropic.claude-v2 with Text input and Text, Chat output, separately from Claude 2.1. The indexed table is historical (search metadata approximately 1.4 years old); direct opening now redirects to a relocation notice. Used only for last-documented modalities, not current availability.

sources.title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Claude Code
sources.evidence: February 24, 2025 announcement describes Claude 3.7 as the first hybrid reasoning model and explains its optional extended-thinking mode. This later feature is not evidence that Claude 2.0 exposes a dedicated reasoning mode.

name.note: Original public name is Claude 2; later card and retirement documentation identify this exact revision as Claude 2.0 / claude-2.0.

developer.note: Explicitly identified as developer in the original model card.

family.note: Normalized family key for the card's Claude model lineage.

release_date.note: Dated announcement states public chat access begins that day and announces API access. This is the original release, before the November 2.1 update.

open_weights.note: Contemporaneous Claude 2 security policy explicitly restricts weight access and protects weights against unsanctioned release; service terms grant no general intellectual-property rights.

license.note: License category supported by protected model intellectual property and contractual service access; not an SPDX license name or a claim that the June 2025 terms were the launch-day terms.

parameters_b.note: No total count in the original card, 2.1 appendix or checked later Claude 3/3.5 comparison tables. No numerical estimate adopted.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact-model active count disclosed in the inspected cards; no density or equality with total parameters assumed.

architecture.note: Original card explicitly identifies Transformer architecture. Dense versus MoE and detailed topology remain undisclosed.

context_window.note: Released 2.0 product limit. Later appendix says 2.0 was trained for 200K, but only 100K was supported at launch; full 200K support belongs to 2.1.

modalities.note: Launch describes text prompts and generated text. Historical official provider table explicitly lists Text input and Text/Chat output; Chat is normalized to text.

reasoning.note: General reasoning benchmark improvements and scaffolded scratchpad text do not establish a dedicated reasoning mode. Later 3.7 extended thinking is not transferred to 2.0; a categorical feature flag remains unresolved.

tool_call.note: Scope differs across sources: the original card permits search-tool integrations, AWS documents a 2.0 function-call parser, and Anthropic introduces native API tool use with 2.1. A provider-independent native tool-call boolean for 2.0 is not established.

description.value: Anthropic's July 2023 Claude text model, using a Transformer architecture and a 100K-token public context window. The claude-2.0 API model was retired on July 21, 2025.
description.note: Replaces the generic historical description with exact release, architecture, context and retirement facts.

patch.description: Anthropic's July 2023 Claude text model, using a Transformer architecture and a 100K-token public context window. The claude-2.0 API model was retired on July 21, 2025.
patch.notes: Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed in the inspected original and later comparison cards. Transformer architecture is documented; dense versus MoE is not. Claude 2.0's publicly supported context was 100K, although the later model-card appendix discloses 200K training context; 2.1 enabled full 200K support. Claude 2.0 retired from the Anthropic API on July 21, 2025. Dedicated reasoning and native tool-call flags remain unresolved; Bedrock Agents' scaffolded function-call parser is distinct from Anthropic's later API tool-use feature.

summary: Confirmed exact Claude 2 / claude-2.0 identity, July 11, 2023 release, Anthropic/Claude lineage, text modalities, proprietary closed weights and 100K public context. Corrected architecture from unknown to Transformer and added the verified July 21, 2025 retirement to the description. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed after inspecting the original card, 2.1 appendix and later Claude 3/3.5 comparison tables. The 200K training context does not change the 2.0 public limit. Reasoning and native tool-call booleans remain unverified because benchmark capability and provider scaffolding do not resolve the feature definitions.
